name: Equalizer APO (Windows, system-wide, live)
notes: Not a phone app you type values into -- AuraTune writes Equalizer APO's config.txt directly and it re-reads the file within a moment, so the adaptation lands on whatever is playing, system-wide. Free/open source, Windows only: https://equalizerapo.com. Setup in docs/equalizer_apo_setup.md. 10 octave-spaced bands as parametric peaking filters, plus a real preamp so boosts can't clip.
